title: कडाइका साथ छुट्याउने नियम
blocks: p

यो अध्याय एउटै नियममा टिकेको छ। Lexical Resource-मा नम्बर पाउने कि नपाउने भन्ने कुरा अरू कुनै एउटा बानीभन्दा यही नियमले बढी तय गर्छ: informal idiom-को ठाउँ Speaking हो, Writing Task 2 होइन। जुन expression-ले interview-मा तपाईंलाई नम्बर दिलाउँछ, त्यही expression-ले essay-मा नम्बर घटाउन सक्छ। यो लेख्ने शैलीको सानो रोजाइको कुरा होइन; यो register-को नियम हो, र माथिल्लो band-मा ठ्याक्कै register-कै जाँच हुन्छ।
p

यो भिन्नता किन यति कडा छ, हेरौं। IELTS Speaking-ले स्वाभाविक, तुरुन्तै बोलिएको भाषालाई नम्बर दिन्छ। त्यसैले ठीक ठाउँमा राखिएको idiom (it was a blessing in disguise, I was over the moon) ले देखाउँछ कि तपाईं धाराप्रवाह बोल्ने मान्छेले जस्तै English प्रयोग गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ। तर Writing Task 2 चाहिँ एउटा formal academic essay हो।
p

त्यहाँ idiom पढ्दा हल्का, गम्भीर नभएको र नमिल्दो लाग्छ। Idiom जतिसुकै राम्रो भए पनि यसले तपाईंको लेखाइको tone-लाई Band 6 तिर तान्छ। Examiner-ले “यो candidate-लाई idiom आउँछ कि आउँदैन” भनेर सोधिरहेका हुँदैनन्। Examiner-ले “कुन किसिमको भाषा कहाँ मिल्छ भनेर यो candidate-लाई थाहा छ कि छैन” भनेर सोधिरहेका हुन्छन्।
h2
निर्णय गर्ने नियम
ul
**Task 2-का लागि सुरक्षित:** के यो पत्रिकाको सम्पादकीय वा academic article-मा स्वाभाविक सुनिन्छ? सुनिन्छ भने essay-मा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
**Speaking-का लागि राख्नुहोस्:** के यो साथीसँगको गफमा सुहाउँछ? सुहाउँछ भने यसलाई Writing Task 2 बाट टाढा राख्नुहोस्।
note

**Phrasal verb:** धेरै phrasal verb तटस्थ हुन्छन् र लेखाइमा पूरै ठीक हुन्छन् (carry out, bring about, result in)। Task 2 बाट टाढा राख्नुपर्ने चाहिँ informal, idiom जस्ता phrasal verb हुन्: get its act together, cough up, र pull your socks up। शंका लागे एउटै formal verb रोज्नुहोस् (organise, pay, improve)।

title: Speaking-का ५० वटा idiom (१–२५)
blocks: tip
Interview-मा स्वाभाविक सुनिन यिनीहरू प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। Part लेबलले कुन idiom कहाँ सबैभन्दा राम्रो मिल्छ भनेर देखाउँछ। यीमध्ये कुनै पनि Task 2 essay-मा नलैजानुहोस्।
h2
Part 1
ul
**once in a blue moon**: धेरै कमै, कहिलेकाहीं मात्र। उदाहरण: I eat out once in a blue moon.
**a piece of cake**: धेरै सजिलो। उदाहरण: For me, cooking is a piece of cake.
**cost an arm and a leg**: धेरै महँगो हुनु। उदाहरण: Concert tickets cost an arm and a leg.
**a stone’s throw away**: धेरै नजिक। उदाहरण: My office is a stone’s throw away from home.
**a rip-off**: चाहिनेभन्दा धेरै बढी दाम लिइने कुरा। उदाहरण: That cafe is a total rip-off.
**hit it off**: पहिलो भेटमै मिल्नु, तुरुन्तै राम्रो सम्बन्ध बन्नु। उदाहरण: We hit it off the moment we met.
**call it a day**: दिनभरको काम सक्नु, काम रोक्नु। उदाहरण: By six, I usually call it a day.
**get the hang of it**: कुनै काम कसरी गर्ने भनेर सिक्नु। उदाहरण: It took me a week to get the hang of it.
**lend a hand**: सहयोग गर्नु। उदाहरण: I often lend a hand at home.
**money doesn’t grow on trees**: पैसा सीमित हुन्छ, सजिलै आउँदैन। उदाहरण: My parents always said money doesn’t grow on trees.
**hit the books**: मन लगाएर धेरै पढ्नु। उदाहरण: I need to hit the books this weekend.
h2
Part 2
ul
**over the moon**: एकदमै खुसी। उदाहरण: I was over the moon when I passed.
**on cloud nine**: असाध्यै खुसी, आनन्दमा डुबेको। उदाहरण: On my wedding day, I was on cloud nine.
**down in the dumps**: दुःखी वा मन खिन्न। उदाहरण: I felt down in the dumps after the result.
**butterflies in my stomach**: उत्साहसँगै आउने घबराहट। उदाहरण: I had butterflies in my stomach before the interview.
**get cold feet**: अन्तिम घडीमा डराउनु वा पछि हट्न मन लाग्नु। उदाहरण: I nearly got cold feet before the speech.
**a fish out of water**: नयाँ ठाउँ वा परिवेशमा असहज महसुस गर्नु। उदाहरण: On my first day abroad, I felt like a fish out of water.
**the last straw**: सहन सकिने अन्तिम कुरा, जसपछि धैर्य टुट्छ। उदाहरण: The delay was the last straw.
**a blessing in disguise**: असफलता वा नराम्रो घटनाभित्र लुकेको फाइदा। उदाहरण: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
**the icing on the cake**: माथिबाट थपिएको खुसीको बोनस। उदाहरण: The view was the icing on the cake.
**in at the deep end**: कुनै तयारी बिना गाह्रो काममा सिधै हालिनु। उदाहरण: I was thrown in at the deep end on day one.
**burn the midnight oil**: राति अबेरसम्म काम गर्नु वा पढ्नु। उदाहरण: Before finals, I burn the midnight oil.
h2
Part 3
ul
**go the extra mile**: विशेष मेहनत गर्नु, चाहिनेभन्दा बढी गर्नु। उदाहरण: Good teachers go the extra mile.
**pull your socks up**: आफ्नो प्रयास सुधार्नु, अझ मेहनत गर्नु। उदाहरण: I had to pull my socks up after the mock test.
**get the ball rolling**: कुनै काम सुरु गर्नु। उदाहरण: Let me get the ball rolling on the project.

title: Speaking-का ५० वटा idiom (२६–५०)
blocks: h2
Part 3
ul
**get to grips with**: बुझ्न वा सम्हाल्न थाल्नु। उदाहरण: It takes time to get to grips with a new city.
**a foot in the door**: सुरुको मौका, भित्र छिर्ने पहिलो अवसर। उदाहरण: An internship gets your foot in the door.
**spread your wings**: आत्मनिर्भर बन्नु र नयाँ कुरा गरेर हेर्नु। उदाहरण: University lets young people spread their wings.
**keep up with the times**: समयसँगै अगाडि बढ्नु, अपडेट रहनु। उदाहरण: Businesses must keep up with the times.
**hit the nail on the head**: ठ्याक्कै सही कुरा भन्नु। उदाहरण: You’ve hit the nail on the head.
**see the bigger picture**: पूरै परिस्थिति बुझ्नु। उदाहरण: Leaders must see the bigger picture.
**think outside the box**: नयाँ र रचनात्मक तरिकाले सोच्नु। उदाहरण: Innovation means thinking outside the box.
**keep an open mind**: नयाँ विचार सुन्न र स्वीकार्न तयार रहनु। उदाहरण: It helps to keep an open mind.
**sit on the fence**: कुनै पक्ष नलिनु, बीचमा बस्नु। उदाहरण: On this issue, I refuse to sit on the fence.
**a mixed blessing**: राम्रो र नराम्रो दुवै पक्ष भएको कुरा। उदाहरण: Social media is a mixed blessing.
**the best of both worlds**: एकैपटक दुई वटा फाइदा। उदाहरण: Remote work offers the best of both worlds.
**every cloud has a silver lining**: नराम्रो कुराबाट पनि राम्रो निस्कन सक्छ। उदाहरण: Every cloud has a silver lining.
**on the same wavelength**: एउटै किसिमले सोच्ने, विचार मिल्ने। उदाहरण: My colleague and I are on the same wavelength.
**in the same boat**: एउटै गाह्रो अवस्थामा परेको। उदाहरण: During the crisis, we were all in the same boat.
**kill two birds with one stone**: एउटै कामबाट दुई वटा काम फत्ते गर्नु। उदाहरण: Cycling to work kills two birds with one stone.
**at the drop of a hat**: तुरुन्तै, कुनै हिचकिचाहट बिना। उदाहरण: She would travel at the drop of a hat.
**add fuel to the fire**: नराम्रो अवस्थालाई झन् नराम्रो बनाउनु। उदाहरण: His comment only added fuel to the fire.
**a needle in a haystack**: भेट्टाउन लगभग असम्भव कुरा। उदाहरण: Finding a quiet flat there is like finding a needle in a haystack.
**pull strings**: आफ्नो पहुँच वा प्रभाव प्रयोग गरेर केही पाउनु। उदाहरण: He pulled strings to get the job.
**face the music**: आफ्नो कामको नतिजा स्वीकार गर्नु। उदाहरण: Sooner or later, you have to face the music.
**bite off more than you can chew**: आफूले सक्नेभन्दा धेरै काम हातमा लिनु। उदाहरण: I bit off more than I could chew last term.
h2
Part 2
ul
**learn something the hard way**: गाह्रो अनुभवबाट सिक्नु। उदाहरण: I learned time management the hard way.
**in the middle of nowhere**: धेरै टाढा, सुनसान ठाउँमा। उदाहरण: The resort was in the middle of nowhere.
**a change of scenery**: ठाउँ बदल्दा पाइने ताजगी। उदाहरण: A holiday gives you a change of scenery.
**the trip of a lifetime**: जीवनभर नबिर्सिने यात्रा। उदाहरण: Visiting the mountains was the trip of a lifetime.

title: Writing-का ५० वटा collocation (१–२५)
blocks: tip
यिनीहरू Writing Task 2 मा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। हरेक collocation formal छ र essay-का लागि मिल्छ।
h2
सुरुवात र विषय प्रस्तुत गर्ने
ul
**it is widely acknowledged that**: धेरैले सत्य भनेर मान्छन् कि। उदाहरण: It is widely acknowledged that education reduces poverty.
**there is no denying that**: यो अस्वीकार गर्न सकिँदैन कि। उदाहरण: There is no denying that technology has reshaped work.
**a growing body of evidence suggests that**: बढ्दो अनुसन्धानले देखाउँछ कि। उदाहरण: A growing body of evidence suggests that pollution harms cognition.
**it can be argued that**: यस्तो दाबी गर्न सकिन्छ कि। उदाहरण: It can be argued that fees limit access.
**this essay will examine both views**: essay सन्तुलित हुन्छ भनेर संकेत गर्छ। उदाहरण: This essay will examine both views before offering an opinion.
**a widely held view**: धेरैले मान्ने विचार। उदाहरण: A widely held view is that competition improves standards.
h2
तर्क बनाउने
ul
**it stands to reason that**: यो तर्कसंगत छ कि। उदाहरण: It stands to reason that better roads reduce delays.
**a compelling argument**: विश्वास दिलाउने तर्क। उदाहरण: There is a compelling argument for renewable subsidies.
**a valid point**: मनासिब दाबी। उदाहरण: Opponents make a valid point about cost.
**proponents argue that**: समर्थकहरू दाबी गर्छन् कि। उदाहरण: Proponents argue that automation raises productivity.
**critics contend that**: विरोधीहरू जोड दिएर भन्छन् कि। उदाहरण: Critics contend that it destroys jobs.
**it is worth noting that**: यो कुरा ध्यान दिन लायक छ कि। उदाहरण: It is worth noting that results vary by region.
h2
कारण र प्रभाव
ul
**play a pivotal role in**: केन्द्रीय रूपमा महत्त्वपूर्ण हुनु। उदाहरण: Education plays a pivotal role in development.
**give rise to**: कारण बन्नु, जन्माउनु। उदाहरण: Rapid growth gives rise to inequality.
**stem from**: कुनै कुराबाट सुरु हुनु, त्यहीँबाट उत्पन्न हुनु। उदाहरण: Many problems stem from poverty.
**be attributed to**: कुनै कारणले व्याख्या गरिनु। उदाहरण: The decline can be attributed to weak demand.
**a contributing factor**: धेरै कारणमध्ये एउटा। उदाहरण: Poor diet is a contributing factor in obesity.
**have far-reaching consequences**: टाढासम्म असर पर्नु। उदाहरण: Climate change has far-reaching consequences.
**as a direct result of**: सिधै त्यसकै कारणले। उदाहरण: As a direct result of the ban, sales fell.
h2
भिन्नता र स्वीकार
ul
**while it is true that**: कुनै कुरा मानेर लिँदा। उदाहरण: While it is true that costs are high, benefits outweigh them.
**contrary to popular belief**: धेरैले मान्ने विचारको उल्टो। उदाहरण: Contrary to popular belief, remote work can raise output.
**despite the fact that**: पूरा concession clause सुरु गर्छ। उदाहरण: Despite the fact that it is costly, the plan is justified.
**on the one hand … on the other hand**: दुई पक्षलाई सन्तुलनमा राख्दै। उदाहरण: On the one hand it saves time; on the other, it isolates people.
**to a certain extent**: केही हदसम्म। उदाहरण: This is true to a certain extent.
h2
समाधान र मूल्यांकन
ul
**address the issue**: समस्या समाधान गर्न काम गर्नु। उदाहरण: Governments must address the issue urgently.

title: Writing-का ५० वटा collocation (२६–५०)
blocks: h2
समाधान र मूल्यांकन
ul
**tackle the root cause**: समस्याको जरो कारणमाथि काम गर्नु। उदाहरण: Lasting change means tackling the root cause.
**implement effective measures**: राम्रा नीति लागू गर्नु। उदाहरण: Cities should implement effective measures against pollution.
**a viable solution**: काम गर्ने, व्यावहारिक समाधान। उदाहरण: Public transport is a viable solution to congestion.
**weigh the pros and cons**: दुवै पक्ष विचार गर्नु। उदाहरण: Policymakers must weigh the pros and cons.
**strike a balance between**: दुई कुराबीच उचित बीचको बाटो खोज्नु। उदाहरण: We must strike a balance between growth and conservation.
**take into account**: विचार गर्नु, ध्यानमा राख्नु। उदाहरण: Any policy must take into account rural needs.
h2
मात्रा, स्तर र समय
ul
**a significant proportion of**: उल्लेख्य हिस्सा। उदाहरण: A significant proportion of graduates work abroad.
**the vast majority of**: लगभग सबै। उदाहरण: The vast majority of commuters use trains.
**in the long run**: लामो समयमा। उदाहरण: In the long run, prevention is cheaper.
**in the short term**: छिट्टै, छोटो समयका लागि। उदाहरण: In the short term, costs may rise.
**an integral part of**: अनिवार्य अंग। उदाहरण: Art is an integral part of education.
**gain momentum**: बल बढ्दै जानु, गति लिनु। उदाहरण: The movement has gained momentum.
h2
असर र मोलतोल
ul
**pose a serious threat to**: खतरामा पार्नु। उदाहरण: Rising seas pose a serious threat to coasts.
**have a detrimental effect on**: हानि गर्नु। उदाहरण: Stress has a detrimental effect on health.
**reap the benefits of**: फाइदा पाउनु, फल भोग्नु। उदाहरण: Future generations will reap the benefits of this investment.
**at the expense of**: अर्को कुरा त्याग गरेर। उदाहरण: Growth should not come at the expense of the environment.
h2
उदाहरण र जोड
ul
**a case in point**: ठ्याक्कै मिल्ने उदाहरण। उदाहरण: Singapore is a case in point.
**to illustrate this**: उदाहरण दिन। उदाहरण: To illustrate this, consider public transport in Tokyo.
**bear in mind that**: याद राख्नु। उदाहरण: We must bear in mind that resources are finite.
**shed light on**: स्पष्ट पार्नु। उदाहरण: The study sheds light on the causes.
**in light of**: विचार गर्दा, यसलाई हेरेर। उदाहरण: In light of these findings, reform is needed.
h2
धारणा र निष्कर्ष
ul
**from my perspective**: मेरो विचारमा। उदाहरण: From my perspective, the benefits outweigh the risks.
**more often than not**: प्रायः। उदाहरण: More often than not, early action is cheaper.
**by and large**: सामान्यतया। उदाहरण: By and large, the policy has succeeded.
**draw a firm conclusion**: स्पष्ट निर्णयमा पुग्नु। उदाहरण: It is difficult to draw a firm conclusion from limited data.

title: Practice · Register छुट्याउने र idiom सच्याउने
blocks: exercise

blocks.title: Exercise 5.1 · Register र Style छुट्याउने
blocks.instructions: तलको हरेक वाक्य Writing Task 2 essay-मा लेखिएको जस्तो गरी लेखिएको छ। Underline गरिएको भाषा formal essay-का लागि ठीक छ (W लेख्नुहोस्) कि Speaking-का लागि मात्र हो (S लेख्नुहोस्), छुट्याउनुहोस्। हरेक S-का लागि वाक्यलाई Task 2 मा मिल्ने formal academic English-मा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Nowadays, a lot of kids are glued to their phones around the clock.
items.answer: S — These days, many children spend excessive time on their smartphones.
items.reason: A lot of kids, glued to, around the clock — यी सबै informal हुन्।

items.prompt: It is widely acknowledged that education reduces poverty.
The government needs to get its act together on pollution.
items.answer: S — The government must take decisive action on pollution.
items.reason: Get its act together informal हो।

items.prompt: This policy could have far-reaching consequences.
At the end of the day, it is up to the individual.
items.answer: S — Ultimately, the responsibility lies with the individual.
items.reason: At the end of the day, it is up to — यी informal हुन्।

items.prompt: Renewable energy plays a pivotal role in cutting emissions.
Fast food is a rip-off and bad for you.
items.answer: S — Fast food is both overpriced and detrimental to health.
items.reason: A rip-off, bad for you — यी informal हुन्।

items.prompt: There is no denying that technology has transformed education.
Loads of people reckon that exams are unfair.
items.answer: S — A significant proportion of people believe that exams are unfair.
items.reason: Loads of, reckon — यी informal हुन्।

items.prompt: Poverty can be attributed to a range of social factors.
Young people these days could not care less about tradition.
items.answer: S — Many young people today show little interest in tradition.
items.reason: Could not care less informal हो।

items.prompt: Governments must strike a balance between growth and conservation.
Social media is a double-edged sword, to be honest.
items.answer: S — Social media brings both clear benefits and serious drawbacks.
items.reason: To be honest बोलीचालीमा प्रयोग हुने hedge हो।

items.prompt: This crisis stems from decades of underinvestment.
If you ask me, the whole system is a mess.
items.answer: S — In my view, the current system is deeply flawed.
items.reason: If you ask me, a mess — यी informal हुन्।

items.prompt: A growing body of evidence suggests a link between diet and disease.
Tourism can boost the economy, but it is a bit of a mixed bag.
items.answer: S — Tourism can boost the economy, though it brings mixed outcomes.
items.reason: A bit of a mixed bag informal हो।

items.prompt: In the long run, prevention is cheaper than treatment.
The rich should cough up more tax.
items.answer: S — The wealthy should contribute more in taxes.

items.prompt: It is worth noting that not all solutions are equally effective.

blocks.instructions: तलको हरेक Speaking उत्तरमा एउटा idiom छ, जुन गलत याद गरिएको, गलत ठाउँमा प्रयोग गरिएको वा पूरै गलत छ। Underline गरिएको भागलाई सही र स्वाभाविक रूपमा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्। सही idiom type गर्नुहोस्।
